summary_en: GEOLIVE Group updated its approach to capital cost and stock price-conscious management on August 31, 2026. The company analyzed its current status and outlined future improvement initiatives following a board review.
title_en: Update on Initiatives for Realizing Capital Cost and Stock Price-Conscious Management
translation_en_brief:
On August 31, 2026, GEOLIVE Group's Board of Directors reviewed and updated the company's approach to realizing management that is conscious of capital costs and stock price performance. The update involved a reassessment of the company's current status and outlined future improvement initiatives to strengthen capital cost and stock price-conscious management practices.

The disclosure indicates this is a progress update rather than introduction of new policies. Specific targets, metrics, and timelines are detailed in the attached materials referenced in the announcement.
